pricing.title: Simple pricing for hiring teams.
pricing.description: Unlimited applications, candidates, jobs, and pipeline stages. Plans differ by team scale, collaboration depth, and branding control.
pricing.positioningLine: One hire easily covers the monthly cost.
pricing.unlimitedUsageLine: Job performance is tied to plan job limits, job post volume, and team size.
pricing.unlimitedUsageHint: Job-based limits ensure consistent platform performance and fair usage.
pricing.trialBadge: 14-day free trial. No credit card required.
pricing.whatsAppAlertsTooltip: OnCampus sends team alerts for applications and pipeline stages, and you can optionally connect your own WhatsApp Business number for candidate messaging. Meta conversation charges are billed directly to the company.
pricing.whatsAppAutoLine1: The system sends WhatsApp alerts automatically for operational workflows.
pricing.whatsAppAutoLine2: When you connect your own WhatsApp Business number, Meta conversation charges are billed directly to your company.
pricing.whatsAppExtraLine: Meta conversation charges are billed directly to your company.
pricing.coreSystemLine: All core features are available in every plan.
pricing.whatsAppSenderModesLine: WhatsApp alerts are included in every plan. You can connect your WhatsApp Business number for automated candidate notifications.
pricing.freeOutcome: Run your hiring process with an entry-level free plan.
pricing.annualLine1: Switch to Yearly and pay only 10 months for full-year access.
pricing.annualLine2: Pay yearly to save two months.
pricing.trust9: WhatsApp alerts work with your own business number setup.
pricing.sectionRoi: How the system pays for itself
pricing.roiLine1: One successful hire easily covers your monthly plan cost.
pricing.roiLine2: Long-term hiring efficiency with repeatable team performance.
pricing.faq1Question: Can I upgrade my plan later?
pricing.faq1Answer: Yes. You can upgrade anytime from your account settings.
pricing.faq2Question: What happens if I exceed my user limit?
pricing.faq2Answer: Adding new users requires an upgrade. All existing operations continue uninterrupted.
pricing.faq3Answer: Yes. Every account includes a 14-day free trial. No credit card is required to start.
pricing.faq4Answer: OnCampus can send alerts to your team when applications or pipeline stages occur. You can also connect your own WhatsApp Business number to automate messages to candidates. WhatsApp conversation charges are billed directly by Meta.
pricing.supportItem4: WhatsApp support during working hours (Mon–Sat, 10 AM – 7 PM)
